checks.observation: All 299 Flutter tests passed before the release version bump; all 299 passed again after the version bump.

checks.observation: flutter analyze --no-pub completed without issues before and after the version bump.

checks.name: Local signed ABI APK build
checks.observation: All three release APKs passed apksigner verification and report versionName 1.0.14. Generated build outputs are ignored and were not added to Git.

checks.name: GitVerse signed ABI APK build
checks.observation: Workflow run 1691408 built all three APKs: arm64-v8a 37.6 MiB, armeabi-v7a 29.4 MiB and x86_64 43 MiB.

checks.name: GitVerse release asset upload
checks.observation: The release metadata was created, but upload of the first arm64-v8a APK failed with context deadline exceeded. The release page currently exposes only source archives and no APK attachments.

failure_or_blocker: The public actions/create-release@v1 action applies a fixed 10-second request timeout. GitVerse did not accept the 37.6 MiB arm64-v8a asset before that deadline. The Android v1.0.14 release is not deliverable until APK assets are uploaded.
